metadata.tagline: From prompt to production-ready frontend in one session.
metadata.description: Scaffold a fully themed, sidebar-navigated component showcase with 28 UI components, OKLCH color palettes, light/dark mode, and WCAG AA contrast — all in one AI session. Supports Next.js 15, React + Vite, Vue 3, Nuxt 4, and SvelteKit with 13 UI library integrations.
features: 28 UI components across 6 categories with live examples and collapsible code snippets
13 UI library integrations (shadcn/ui, MUI, Chakra, Mantine, Ant Design, HeroUI, HeadlessUI, DaisyUI, Bootstrap, Vuetify, PrimeVue, Element Plus, Custom Tailwind)
OKLCH color palette generator with 8 named presets + custom hex/OKLCH input
50–950 color scales for neutral and accent
WCAG AA contrast verification baked into the palette pipeline
Light/dark mode with FOUC prevention and localStorage persistence
Tailwind v4 (default) with automatic v3 fallback for incompatible combinations
TypeScript or JavaScript, any of four package managers (bun/pnpm/yarn/npm)
Optional pairing with ui-ux-pro-max skill for higher-fidelity component output
Plain CommonMark only — compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, and more
